behavior: WSJ remained outside the motion scope and received HOLD throughout.
Yunji completed 13 source rounds without a plant semantic arrival; every completed round recorded target_found=false.

Round 7 selected FRONTIER_POINT B at shared-world (-1.551943, -1.833756); the operator observed that this branch led away from the plant, and the continuity guard retained it while measured progress continued.
Later source frontiers were projected to footprint-clear bounded approaches; local unreachable frontiers were isolated and replanned without terminating the run as an engineering error.
The final two cross-round displacements were 0.003037 m and 0.002637 m, below the 0.05 m threshold, so the second stagnant interval triggered cross_round_no_progress_hold.
The episode ended with Yunji and the inactive WSJ in HOLD, velocity_zero_confirmed=true, and Hub GOAL output disabled for both robots.
